voice_instruction: A native Latin American Spanish male speaker in his thirties with a natural Argentine accent. Warm, clear mid-range voice. He explains medical software to a colleague in a relaxed, conversational and confident way. Fluid connected sentences with natural varied intonation, small meaningful pauses and a brisk but comfortable pace. Clean close-microphone studio sound.
review: La naturalidad, el acento y la pronunciación requieren escuchar esta muestra. No se reemplazó el audio ni el guion del montaje.
